text:
Maya: quick heads-up — proposing a quota-smoothing option for invoice-preview to reduce spikes 🤞
Sam: SGTM, can you sketch how smoothing interacts with route fallback?
Maya: rough idea: apply a short moving-window dampener on bursts before we materialize invoice events. Not changing final accounting, just the preview aggregation window.
Lee: hmm... "not changing final accounting" is tricky — previews and invoices must reconcile. How do we avoid customer confusion when preview <> invoice? :thinking: 
Maya: plan: preserve canonical events for ledger; previews get optional smoothing + explainers in console. Final invoices still use raw tokens. Smoothing is only for UX.
Ana: telemetry needs: mark preview events with `preview_smoothing=true`, capture smoothing factor, original_raw_tokens. Also tag route resolution id.
Julian: console UX: show a small badge "smoothed preview" with hover text, and an expand to see raw numbers. Could add toggle per-org.
Sam: rollout: start with internal-only tenants, then 5% canary orgs, metric: diff between preview and invoice < 0.5% for 95th pctile.
Lee: what about ratecard edges? If smoothing hides a burst that triggers a price tier, customer could be surprised.
Maya: good point — if smoothing would hide crossing a tier threshold we surface a warning and don't smooth that window.
metering-bot: alert created #metering-alerts: preview-smoothing-canary scheduled 2025-08-12 03:00 UTC
Ana: will add tags to metering pipeline: `preview: smoothed` + provenance header. Need schema update and migration notes.
Sam: does this affect dedupe windows or the invoice finalizer? We must ensure canonical event ordering remains stable.
Maya: no change to dedupe / finalizer. Only alter preview aggregator step. We'll add an audit log to track mapping from smoothed-buckets -> raw-events.
Julian: UX mocks incoming, will wire to preview API flag `?smoothing=true` for the console calls.
Lee: ok but we need a strong telemetry dashboard: preview_vs_invoice drift, per-route, per-tenant. Ops needs alerts when divergence > threshold.
Ana: agreed. I'll draft dataflow: small ETL job generates reconciliation table daily with `preview_tokens, invoice_tokens, diff_pct`.
Sam: timeline? can we aim for canary in 3 weeks?
Maya: target: canary deploy 3w, expand in 2w if metrics look good. I'll post a follow-up RFC with config, contracts, and rollbacks.
Julian: +1, cc @growth for UX copy
Maya: thanks — will loop in billing audit for compliance signoff.
Sam: ping when RFC posted
Maya: posted: https://rwd.internal/rfcs/preview-smoothing (draft)
Lee: quick nit: make sure we version preview schema so older console clients still see raw previews.
Maya: yep versioned API v2-preview with `smoothing` field. ok closing for now, will update thread with RFC link and metrics plan :rocket:
